en_summary: $GOOGL should consider spinning off Google Cloud, which could be worth nearly $1.5T on its own at 12x revenue given ~$123B annual run rate, doubling revenue, 36% margins and $561B backlog. $ORCL, Anthropic and OpenAI already using Google's TPUs; standalone Cloud could be a more neutral supplier.
text:
I think $GOOGL should seriously consider spinning off Google Cloud because on its own it could be worth nearly $1.5T and become one of ten most valuable companies in the world.

The numbers are insane with Cloud doubling revenue at a ~$123B annual run rate alongside 36% margins and a $561B backlog which would put it near that $1.5T valuation at 12x revenue.

And beyond the valuation I think there's another interesting angle because $ORCL, Anthropic and OpenAI are already turning to Google's TPUs despite competing with its AI products so a standalone Cloud business could become a more neutral supplier without being tied to all the concerns surrounding Search.

name: The Wolf Of All Streets
zh_summary: Binance lost about $6.3B in Thursday's hack, largest crypto theft on record, ~4x Bybit's $1.5B in Feb 2025. Drain started 4:05 PM ET Oct 29, most left in 20 minutes across 10 chains. Binance set aside $6.34B to cover users ($5B already in stolen tokens). ~$3B frozen on-chain mostly $USDT/$USDC. Attacker holds 18,270 $BTC. Attributed to North Korean TraderTraitor. Withdrawals restart targeting early Sunday, PoR Monday.
en_summary: Binance lost about $6.3B in Thursday's hack, largest crypto theft on record, ~4x Bybit's $1.5B in Feb 2025. Drain started 4:05 PM ET Oct 29, most left in 20 minutes across 10 chains. Binance set aside $6.34B to cover users ($5B already in stolen tokens). ~$3B frozen on-chain mostly $USDT/$USDC. Attacker holds 18,270 $BTC. Attributed to North Korean TraderTraitor. Withdrawals restart targeting early Sunday, PoR Monday.
text:
Binance lost about $6.3 billion in Thursday's hack. It is the largest crypto theft on record in dollar terms, roughly four times the $1.5 billion taken from Bybit in February 2025.

The drain started at 4:05 PM ET on Oct 29. TRM Labs says most of it left Binance wallets in about 20 minutes, across 10 blockchains.

Binance has set aside $6.34 billion to cover users. $5 billion of that is already held in the exact tokens that were stolen, about 80% of the loss. It is buying the rest through the market and OTC desks.

About $3 billion has been frozen on-chain, almost all of it $USDT and $USDC. The attacker still holds 18,270 $BTC split across 19 wallets. Elliptic says none of it has reached an exchange or service yet.

TRM and Chainalysis attribute the theft with high confidence to TraderTraitor, a North Korean state hacking unit. No government has confirmed it. Trump on Friday: "We don't know. We're looking at that." The FBI and Secret Service are both involved.

TRM counts $12.8 billion stolen by North Korea since 2017. $7.4 billion of it came this year.

Binance is targeting a phased restart of withdrawals early Sunday. Proof of reserves results are due Monday.

Six reports this week. Weight of Evidence: Constructive, selective.
